title: Balance CDQ V22.36 — récupération PC stable

patches.text:
<style id="cdqPcV2236RecoveryCss">
html.pc16-startup-lock,
html.pc16-startup-lock body,
html.pc16-startup-lock #accessOverlay{
  background:#030507 url("https://jprodrigue86.github.io/Rapports--talonnages-CDQ/assets/music-wall-pc-chosen-v2233.webp?v=20260918-v2236") center center / cover no-repeat fixed!important;
}
html.windows #cdqPcV16{background:#04131d!important;}
html.windows #cdqPcV16 .pc16-body{
  top:124px!important;height:706px!important;
  grid-template-columns:214px minmax(0,1fr)!important;
  gap:8px!important;padding-left:0!important;
}
html.windows #cdqPcV16 .pc16-sidebar,
html.windows #cdqPcV16 .pc16-center{height:706px!important;}
html.windows #cdqPcV16 .pc16-sidebar{
  min-width:214px!important;width:auto!important;margin:0!important;padding:8px 10px 10px!important;
  border:1px solid #1e5874!important;border-left:0!important;border-radius:0 7px 7px 0!important;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#061622 0%,#04131d 70%,#05141f 100%)!important;
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 20px rgba(0,0,0,.38)!important;overflow:hidden!important;
}
html.windows #cdqPcV16 .pc16-center{
  grid-template-rows:90px minmax(0,1fr)!important;padding:16px 0 6px!important;
}
html.windows #cdqPcV16 .pc16-main{grid-template-rows:72px minmax(0,1fr) 34px!important;}
html.windows #cdqPcV16 .pc16-table-wrap{padding-bottom:2px!important;}
html.windows #cdqPcV16 .pc16-shortcuts{bottom:84px!important;}
html.windows #cdqPcV16 .pc16-side-status{left:12px!important;right:12px!important;bottom:8px!important;}
html.windows #cdqPcV16 .pc16-kpi[data-follow="clients"],
html.windows #cdqPcV16 .pc16-kpi[data-follow="clients"] *{
  animation:none!important;transition:none!important;filter:none!important;text-shadow:none!important;
}
html.windows #cdqPcV16 .pc16-kpi[data-follow="clients"]{--c:#20c8e8!important;}
</style>
<script id="cdqPcV2236RecoveryJs">
(function(){
  'use strict';
  function stamp(){
    var root=document.getElementById('cdqPcV16');if(!root)return false;
    root.dataset.build='v22.36-pc-recovery-stable';
    var v=root.querySelector('.pc16-side-meta span');if(v)v.textContent='V22.36';
    return true;
  }
  var n=0,t=setInterval(function(){n++;if(stamp()||n>20)clearInterval(t);},250);
})();
</script>
